title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and self\-driven 5\+ years of Senior Data Engineer who can independently design, build, and deliver modern data platforms and analytics solutions. We are seeking professionals who can take ownership of projects from requirement gathering through architecture design, development, testing, and production deployment.

This role requires strong technical expertise along with the ability to work directly with clients, understand business challenges, and translate them into scalable data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with clients to understand business requirements and data challenges.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end data architectures and modern data platforms.
* Build scalable and high\-performance data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and reporting.
* Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes using modern cloud technologies.
* Design data models, data lakes, data warehouses, and analytics solutions.
* Ensure data quality, governance, security, and performance best practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and engineering teams.
* Take ownership of projects from concept to deployment and ongoing support.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure Data Platform.
* Hands\-on experience with: Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory (ADF), PySpark, Python
* Strong SQL and data modeling skills.
* Experience building scalable data engineering solutions in cloud environments.
* Understanding of data warehousing concepts and modern data architecture patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, source control, and deployment processes.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to gather and analyze business requirements.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and client\-facing experience.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience leading technical discussions and solution design workshops.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power BI or other analytics/reporting platforms.
* Exposure to Snowflake, Delta Lake, or Lakehouse architecture.
* Experience working in consulting or client\-facing environments.
* Azure certifications are a plus.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for professionals who:

* Think beyond coding and understand business outcomes.
* Can design solutions from a blank canvas.
* Take complete ownership of delivery.
* Enjoy solving complex data challenges.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced and collaborative environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

title: Configuration Application Support Engineer
description:
**Job purpose:**

The Configuration Application Support Engineer is responsible for configuring, maintaining, and supporting applications in line with documented business and scheme requirements. The role focuses on day\-to\-day application support, incident resolution, and configuration changes that ensure the platform remains stable, accurate, and available for business users. Working closely with business analysts, developers, and operational teams, the role ensures that changes are implemented correctly, issues are investigated and resolved using data and log analysis, and users receive clear communication and support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide day\-to\-day application support for systems, including investigation and resolution of incidents and service requests. **Perform configuration activities within the application to implement approved changes in line with documented requirements and scheme rules.**  Use SQL queries, logs, and monitoring tools to investigate issues, perform data checks, and validate configuration changes. **Work closely with business analysts and product owners to understand intended system behaviour and clarify requirements where needed.**  Collaborate with developers and testers to support fixes, enhancements, and release activities into test and production environments. **Document configuration changes, known issues, and workarounds in appropriate repositories (e.g. Confluence, knowledge base, ticketing tools).**  Monitor system health, alerts, and performance using available monitoring tools, escalating issues appropriately. **Support root\-cause analysis of recurring incidents and contribute to preventative actions and continuous improvement.**  Communicate clearly with users and stakeholders on incident progress, impact, and resolution, ensuring expectations are managed. **Adhere to SDLC, change management, and security controls when implementing configuration or supporting deployments.**

**Must have:**

* Solid understanding of application architecture fundamentals and how configuration affects system behaviour. **Hands\-on experience with SQL for data investigation, lookups, and validation.**  Experience using monitoring and logging tools to support incident analysis. **Strong problem\-solving skills, including root\-cause and incident analysis.**  Clear written and verbal communication skills for interacting with users and technical teams. **Experience working with collaboration and ticketing tools (e.g. Teams, email, service desk or incident management tools). Nice to have:**  Exposure to Jira and Confluence for documenting requirements and changes. **Familiarity with Agile/Scrum ways of working and SDLC concepts.**  Basic understanding of business analysis, requirements gathering, and process mapping. **Awareness of data modelling and relational database concepts.**  Experience with web applications, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Digital Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

The **AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant** will be responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, and supporting industrial data management solutions using the **AVEVA PI System** and related time\-series technologies. The role involves connecting operational technology (OT) systems such as PLCs, DCS, and SCADA with enterprise applications, ensuring reliable data collection, storage, visualization, and analysis.

The incumbent will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand business and technical requirements, develop scalable solutions, troubleshoot system issues, optimize performance, and maintain system health. The role also includes preparing technical documentation, supporting maintenance and AMC activities, developing automation scripts, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. This position requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving skills, client interaction capabilities, and a proactive approach toward learning emerging industrial data and automation technologies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, configure, and implement solutions using AVEVA PI System and industrial historian technologies.
* Integrate PLC, DCS, SCADA, ERP, MES, and other enterprise systems for seamless data exchange.
* Gather client requirements and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide timely technical support.
* Perform system upgrades, maintenance, health checks, and performance optimization activities.
* Develop dashboards, reports, asset frameworks, calculations, and data visualization solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, user guides, and deployment documents.
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, and PI Web API to improve operational efficiency.
* Support AMC activities, system audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay updated with Industry 4\.0 technologies, industrial data platforms, and best practices.

**Required Skills:**

* AVEVA PI System \& Historian Technologies
* System Integration (PLC, DCS, SCADA, ERP, MES)
* PI Interfaces, Connectors \& PI Web API
* PowerShell and Python Scripting
* SQL, Data Validation \& Data Analysis
* System Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Performance Optimization
* Industrial Automation \& Industry 4\.0 Concepts
* Technical Documentation \& SOP Preparation
* Client Requirement Gathering \& Solution Design
* AMC Support \& Incident Management
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis
* Strong Communication \& Stakeholder Management Skills
* Ability to Work Independently and in Cross\-Functional Teams
* Knowledge of Time\-Series Data Management and Reporting Tools

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹750,000\.00 per year

Experience:

* Office Administration: 4 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
